how_to_apply: Visit the official SDSC SHAR website at www.shar.gov.in or the application portal at apps.shar.gov.in.
Read the detailed notification and identify the post code matching your qualifications.
Open the online application and enter the required personal, educational and contact information.
Provide a valid email address and mobile number.
Select the relevant post code and posting preferences, where applicable.
Upload the photograph, signature and required supporting documents according to the portal specifications.
Pay the applicable processing fee through the online payment facility.
Complete the application submission by 9 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Save the generated Registration Number and application details for future reference.
Multiple Post Codes: Candidates eligible for more than one post code must submit separate applications and pay the prescribed fee separately for each post code.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed post-specific educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions by the application closing date. Technician B applicants must have the NCVT trade qualification corresponding to their selected post code. Important: Boiler Attendant applicants must possess both the prescribed NAC in Boiler Attendant trade and a First Class Boiler Attendant Certificate. A general ITI certificate alone does not meet this specific requirement. For Light Vehicle Driver A and Heavy Vehicle Driver A posts, the prescribed experience must have been gained after obtaining a valid driving licence. Experience certificates must be issued by Government/Semi-Government agencies, registered companies, societies, trusts or other eligible organizations. Experience certificates issued by individuals are not accepted. Part-time driving experience is not considered. Heavy Vehicle Driver candidates must satisfy the specified Public Service Badge conditions.

rows.educational_qualification: First Class Diploma of minimum three years' duration in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognized institution
First Class B.Sc. with Physics as main subject and Mathematics and Chemistry as ancillary subjects
First Class Bachelor of Fine Arts (Photography) or Visual Arts (Cinematography)
First Class Graduation and First Class Master's Degree in Library Science, Library and Information Science or recognized equivalent
First Class Diploma in Nursing of at least three years, recognized by State/Central Government, with registration in the respective State Nursing Council
SSLC/SSC Pass with ITI/NTC/NAC from NCVT in the notified trade
SSLC/SSC Pass with NCVT ITI/NTC/NAC in Draughtsman (Civil)
10th Pass and prescribed Physical Fitness and Endurance Test standards
10th Pass, three years of experience as Light Vehicle Driver and valid Light Vehicle Driving Licence
10th Pass, five years of driving experience including at least three years as Heavy Vehicle Driver, valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence and Public Service Badge where required
Matriculation / SSLC / SSC or equivalent Pass

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum written-test qualifying marks are 32 out of 80 for unreserved candidates and 24 out of 80 for eligible candidates against reserved posts. The minimum qualifying marks for the skill test are 50 out of 100 for unreserved candidates and 40 out of 100 for eligible candidates against reserved posts. The examination duration is 120 minutes, with one mark for each correct answer and a deduction of 0.25 mark for each incorrect answer. The subsequent driving skill test is qualifying in nature. The MTS examination covers Numerical and Mathematical Ability, Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving, General Awareness, and English Language and Comprehension.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ISRO SDSC SHAR for 2026?
faq.answer: Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR has released a total of 97 vacancies for various temporary posts including Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Technician, Driver, Nurse, Fireman, and Multi-Tasking Staff.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online registration process commences on 19 October 2026 and concludes on 9 November 2026. Interested and eligible candidates must complete their submissions well before the closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Technical Assistant and Technician posts?
faq.answer: For Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Nurse, and Technician posts, the age limit is set between 18 and 35 years as on 9 November 2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required for Technician 'B' positions?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Technician 'B' posts must have passed SSLC/SSC/Matriculation along with an ITI, NTC, or NAC certificate in the respective trade from an institute recognized by NCVT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for posts carrying code 07 to 15?
faq.answer: The processing fee for post codes 07 to 15 is Rs. 750 for all candidates. Please check the official notification regarding fee refund policies for candidates appearing in the written test.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection procedure for these roles?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises a Written Test consisting of objective multiple-choice questions, followed by a Skill Test, Physical Efficiency Test, or Detailed Medical Examination depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply for multiple post codes?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple posts if they satisfy the respective eligibility criteria, but they must submit separate applications and fees for each individual post code.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS)?
faq.answer: Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) positions fall under Level 1 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, with a salary ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900/- plus admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted at Satish Dhawan Space Centre SHAR, Sriharikota in Andhra Pradesh, or potentially other affiliated units like ADRIN with an all-India transfer liability.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates access the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the detailed official notification and online application links by visiting the official website at http://www.shar.gov.in or through the direct links provided in this article.
